$comment: FireRedVAD audio event detection (speech / singing / music) for the speech pipeline's music gate (speech::music_gate::MODEL_ID, an A/B that is off by default; owned by P6-L).

FireRedTeam/FireRedVAD (Apache-2.0): the official ONNX export of the AED model (input 'feat' f32 [1, T, 80] Kaldi fbank after global CMVN, output 'probs' f32 [1, T, 3]) and its Kaldi CMVN stats, from the GitHub repository's pretrained_models/onnx_models at a pinned commit (the Hugging Face repo holds only the PyTorch checkpoints). Both files are plain git blobs: git_oid 4df9973272e38084a87475023f1c234fba0ddfbf and 5b21592ae056b8b11ae23074542a175cdf8160a4, verified against the downloads.
Update: re-pin the commit in both URLs, re-hash the two files, and keep MODEL_ID / MODEL_FILE / CMVN_FILE in speech/music_gate.rs in step.

entries.title: FireRedVAD music and singing detector
entries.description: Recognizes music and singing, so the experimental music filter can skip them instead of turning them into captions. About 2.4 MB download.
